# T-10b: Update applyFlipOverride to drop violations on flip

## Goal
Modify applyFlipOverride so that when it flips a FAIL article entry to PASS, the returned entry has no violations field (delete the field on the cloned entry). PASS / SKIP entries without violations are returned unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- applyFlipOverride called with a FAIL article entry containing violations[] returns a clone with result === 'pass' and no violations field.
- Existing flip-marker reason text behavior is preserved (the reason gets the '[flip override: ...]' suffix as today).
- Unit test asserts the absence of the violations field on the flipped entry.

## Implementation Notes
Existing applyFlipOverride is at run-gate.js:1263. Add a destructuring step that omits the violations field when constructing the flipped entry (e.g. const { violations, ...rest } = e; return { ...rest, result: 'pass', reason: ... }).

## Test Strategy
Pure-function unit test on applyFlipOverride with a fixture FAIL entry carrying violations[].
